page.title: A complete platform for building and running automations
page.description: From the first trigger to the last log entry, Telzyra gives you the tools to design workflows visually and run them reliably.

builder.title: Visual Workflow Builder
builder.description: Design automations on a clear canvas by connecting nodes. See the whole process at a glance and change it without touching code.

integrations.title: App Integrations
integrations.description: Connect business apps once and reuse those connections in any workflow, with credentials kept securely in your workspace.

ai.title: AI Automation
ai.description: Add AI steps to classify messages, summarize text or extract structured data from documents, inside the same workflow.

triggers.title: Smart Triggers
triggers.description: Start workflows from webhooks, schedules or app events, so work happens the moment it is needed.

logic.title: Conditional Logic
logic.description: Route data with conditions, filters and branches, so each record follows exactly the path it should.

monitoring.title: Execution Monitoring
monitoring.description: Follow every run with step-by-step logs, input and output data, and clear error messages for fast troubleshooting.

webhooks.title: Webhooks and API Connections
webhooks.description: Receive data from any system with webhooks and call any REST API with HTTP requests, even without a dedicated connector.

templates.title: Workflow Templates
templates.description: Start from ready-made workflow structures for common processes, then adapt each step to your business.

nodesSection.title: Core building blocks
nodesSection.description: Every workflow is made of nodes. Each node has a stable technical identifier, so workflows keep working in every language.
